comments.author: Jebi
comments.body: Would be interesting to see how much acceleration boosts one would get using the Wooden Shovel SE (not available in Maris yet). My guess is that using (1) Wooden Shovel, (2) Physics Research Note and (3) either the Earplug SE (to turn with EA on) or a SE with high sail stats could further boost the sailing capability of the PWJ (or any sail-based trade ship for that matter). Question is whether spending another 2-3CTs per month for the SEMB (SE Maint. Book) is worth the trouble.
